# gitmoap_repository_pipeline_component_files (Data Source)

List the components a ref's files hold. Every component the `.gitmoap/components/` files hold at a branch, a tag or a full ref — the default branch when none is named — with the files it is written in, whether it reads, which tags publish it, the pipelines that use it, whether its files differ from the default branch's, and what this repository has published under its name. A component that does not read is listed all the same, with its errors counted. Anyone who can read the repository's pipelines may list them, without signing in on a public repository.

The token needs `pipeline:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_pipeline_component_files" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository id

### Optional

- `ref` (String) A branch, a tag or a full ref; the default branch when absent

### Read-Only

- `commit_sha` (String) The commit the ref pointed at; every component in the listing was read there.
- `items` (Attributes List) One page of the components, in name order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `blob_sha` (String) Its file's git object id, or its directory's tree id, at this ref.
- `changed_from_default` (Boolean) Whether any of its files differs from the default branch's — always `false` on the default
branch itself.
- `description` (String) What it is for, as its files' `description` says.
- `error_count` (Number) How many errors it has.
- `files` (Attributes List) Every file it is written in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--files))
- `name` (String)
- `path` (String) Where it is written: `.gitmoap/components/<name>.hcl`, or the directory
`.gitmoap/components/<name>`.
- `published` (Attributes) What this repository has published under a component's name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--published))
- `used_by` (List of String) Every pipeline at this ref that uses it, directly or through another of the repository's
components.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether it reads, binds and validates as a component with no error.
- `versioning` (String) Which tags publish a component: only its own `<name>/vX.Y.Z`, or also the repository's plain
`vX.Y.Z` releases.
- `warning_count` (Number) How many warnings it has.

<a id="nestedatt--items--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.files`

Read-Only:

- `blob_sha` (String) The file's git object id at the commit it was read at — what a commit that edits it names
as `expected_blob_sha`.
- `path` (String) The file's path from the repository's root, under `.gitmoap/components/`.


<a id="nestedatt--items--published"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.published`

Read-Only:

- `changed_since_latest` (Boolean) Whether the component's files differ from those its latest version was published from —
`true` means they hold something no version has published. Absent when there is no latest
version, or when it was published before versions recorded their files.
- `component_id` (String)
- `latest_version` (String)
- `version_count` (Number) How many versions have been published.
